rv.q: But sadly it just continues as more of the same, and there is no real play to speak of at all.
This is one of the many reasons why this play deserves a sell-out audience, and by the looks of things, it is starting to happen, so book while you still can!

cn.t: Critics are divided on this dual-cast portrayal of Queen Elizabeth and Margaret Thatcher. While some praise its clever premise and humor, others find the device grows tiresome, with the concept wearing thin by the second half.
